name: A dungeon walked into keeps its authored levels; a Dungeon Finder group sees it scaled
contract: Issues #11184, #11109 and #11272: as on Ascension, a scaled dungeon scales only for a Dungeon Finder group in the
dungeon the finder sent it to. A level-26 character who walks into Maraudon meets its level-45 creatures, with
open world scaling on or off, while a level-26 character of a finder group for Maraudon sees them at 26.

steps.label: The runner's group runs Maraudon through the Dungeon Finder
CONTROL: the finder group's character sees the creature at its own level
With scaling on, the character who walked in sees the authored level 45
